bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EURCV is issued natively by SG Forge on each supported ledger: an Ethereum ERC-20, a Solana Token-2022 mint, an XRP Ledger issued currency, and a Stellar credit asset. Each deployment's issuing authority was read directly on-chain on 2026-07-20; no lock-and-mint or third-party bridge leg carries the claim. Pinned ledger reads on 2026-07-21 sum to 128,041,811.64 EURCV across the four issuer-native deployments. Stellar carries 15,030,600 EURCV, or 11.73882172%, so the chain:stellar common-mode exposure is attributed and remains above the 10% materiality threshold.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Kimi P2 control cohort dc-1 (lead usdt-tether); Phase 3 cur-2 non-EVM controller reads (2026-07-20); SOL-KEYSTONE supply attribution (2026-07-21)
